concerns.text: Task T020c calculates 'Drop = R²(Within-Stress) - R²(Shuffled Baseline)' using the globally shuffled control (T021b). This fails to cover SC-002 and FR-005, which explicitly require measuring the drop when testing on a *different* stress type (cross-stress generalization). The task implements the wrong metric logic.

Task T021a (Null Model comparison) is marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`). SC-001 requires comparing model performance against a 'null model (predicting the mean)'. Without a completed task to implement this comparison, SC-001 is not covered.

Task T037 halts the pipeline if n < 5 samples exist per stress condition. This contradicts the Plan's explicit fallback strategy to use Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOOCV) for datasets where 5 <= n < 50. The task prevents the implementation of the LOOCV logic defined in T019, leaving the 'n < 50' plan element uncovered.
Task T018 (Data Completeness %) is marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`). SC-004 requires measuring data completeness as a percentage of retained datasets. Without this task, SC-004 is not covered.

Task T021b implements a 'Permutation Test (1000 iterations)' for the shuffled baseline. Neither the Spec (FR-005/SC-002) nor the Plan explicitly mandates a permutation test for this specific control (the Plan mentions permutation tests for *multiple comparisons* across stress pairs, not for the baseline control itself). This is a stale/extra requirement not derived from the spec/plan.
